summary: Iteration 92 — Full e2e verification of the two NEW features: (1) Personalized 'For You' rail on Shop home and (2) Bid Autopilot for Category Spotlight. BACKEND (8/8 pytest passed against test@ + demo@ + a fresh ephemeral user): POST /api/shop/track {kind:'view'} returns {ok:true} and logs shop_user_events; GET /api/shop/home for demo user AFTER seeding a browse view returns sections[] containing {key:'for_you', title:'For You', subtitle:'Because you order from Fun Pizza Kitchen & you browse restaurant / food', items:[...]} while a brand-new user with zero history correctly gets NO for_you section (only 'recommended' + other generics), confirming graceful fallback. POST /api/merchant/marketplace/category-bid/autopilot round-trip verified — enabling with {target_rank:1,max_bid_cents:15} returns {ok:true, autopilot:true, bid:{autopilot:true, autopilot_max_bid_cents:15, target_rank:1, bid_cents ∈ [1..15]}, standing:{...}}; GET /category-bid reflects the same fields; disabling with {enabled:false, target_rank:3, max_bid:20} persists (autopilot:false with retained target_rank/max_bid); target_rank=6 and max_bid=5000 both correctly rejected with 422 (Pydantic Field ge/le); reenable at target_rank=3/max_bid=8 auto-lowers bid_cents to 1c (sole bidder). WEB (/shop as demo@ then /shop/merchant/promote as test@): For You section + subtitle 'Because you order from Fun Pizza Kitchen & you browse restaurant / food' visible on /shop; rl-merchant-promote-page + promote-autopilot + promote-autopilot-toggle + promote-autopilot-rank-1/3/5 + promote-autopilot-maxbid + promote-autopilot-status all render; tapping Top-3 chip live-triggers backend and status text updates to 'Holding #1 · bidding 1¢' with maxbid value=8 retained; toggle OFF flip persisted; regression testids all present (promote-bid-save, promote-topup-btn, promote-autotopup-toggle, promote-autorenew-toggle, promote-daily-cap, promote-trend). MOBILE (Expo web preview 390x844, demo-login-btn → /shop then /merchant/promote): shop-section-for_you + shop-section-sub-for_you visible on Shop tab with identical subtitle 'Because you order from Fun Pizza Kitchen & you browse restaurant / food' (parity confirmed); promote-root + promote-autopilot + promote-autopilot-toggle + promote-autopilot-rank + promote-autopilot-rank-1/3/5 + promote-autopilot-maxbid + promote-autopilot-status all render; tapping Top-5 chip updates status to 'Bidding 1¢ — building rank' with max_bid=20; regression testids present (promote-bid-save, promote-topup-btn, promote-daily-cap, promote-autotopup, promote-autotopup-toggle). No red-screen, no red UI errors, no missing testids.
critical_code_review_comments: shop.py::_personalized_section (line 216) — shop_user_events.find({user_id}) is unbounded except by .limit(100) but has no compound index; if a heavy user browses thousands of shops the sort('ts', -1) will hit an in-memory sort. Recommend adding index {user_id:1, ts:-1} on shop_user_events.

shop.py::track (line 45) — every 'view' unconditionally hits marketplace_profiles.find_one + shop_user_events.insert_one on the read path. Consider bulk-batching / fire-and-forget task offload so a burst of card impressions doesn't blow up p95 latency of /shop/home.

shop.py::_personalized_section (line 236) — candidates limited to 60 by category but if the top-3 favored categories are all sparse the rail can be dominated by the same 1-2 places the user already knows (biz_weight bonus is +2 per known biz). Consider capping own-history reranking to avoid a rail that repeats what they've already ordered from.

marketplace_category_bids.py::sweep_autopilot (line 283) — module-level _last_autopilot_sweep is per-worker, same caveat as sweep_topups from iter91: under multi-worker uvicorn each worker will independently sweep every 30s. Not a correctness bug (idempotent bid_cents update) but ~N× the write load. A mongo-level 'skip if autopilot_adjusted_at within N seconds' filter on the doc would harden it.

marketplace_category_bids.py::AutopilotBody (line 260) — max_bid_cents defaults to 20 but has no floor for '≥ current bid'. If a merchant enables autopilot with max_bid=1 while another rival is at 10c they will silently lose the top spot (auto-lowered to 1c, ranking last). UI currently shows status 'building rank' which is fine, but consider surfacing a warning when max_bid < next-competitor_bid+1.

shop.py::shop_home (line 264-268) — every anonymous /shop/home read now triggers sweep_renewals + sweep_topups + sweep_autopilot + maybe_send_weekly_digests. Even with throttles it's 4 collection scans on the hottest read endpoint. Consider moving sweeps to an APScheduler background job instead of piggybacking on reads.

ShopRadioLife.jsx:298 — for_you subtitle rendering uses text-orange-600 on a dark card background: fine contrast, but the mobile screen uses COLORS.primary at fontSize xs (~12pt) which is on the edge of iOS Human Interface Guideline minimums; consider bumping to sm.

success_rate.frontend: Web: For You section+subtitle rendered w/ correct copy + all 6 autopilot testids + live rank-3 tap round-trip working (status shows 'Holding #1 · bidding 1¢') + all 6 regression testids present. Mobile: shop-section-for_you+sub-for_you rendered w/ identical copy + all 6 autopilot testIDs + live rank-5 tap round-trip working (status shows 'Bidding 1¢ — building rank') + all 5 regression testIDs present. Parity: 100%.

test_credentials: Web: demo@bigfm.dubai / DemoPass123! (has orders + browse history — For You populated); test@bigfm.dubai / TestUser123! (merchant biz_dc324d800f66 with active category bid on 'restaurant' + budget + saved card). Mobile: demo-login-btn → demo@bigfm.dubai bearer token.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest: (1) toggled autopilot for test@ merchant to enabled=true target_rank=3 max_bid=8 (sole bidder → auto-lowered bid_cents to 1c), then flipped enabled=false while preserving target_rank/max_bid — final state left as autopilot=true target_rank=3 max_bid=8 bid_cents=1. (2) Registered an ephemeral user iter92_new_<uuid>@example.com for the fallback-negative test. (3) Seeded shop_user_events browse rows for demo user. Web UI live-changed max_bid input to 8 and turned autopilot OFF at end. Mobile UI toggled autopilot ON then OFF (final = off).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (personalized For You rail + Bid Autopilot) are working e2e on shared backend + web + mobile with 100% parity. The only observed edge case: with only ONE bidder in a category, both target_rank=1 and target_rank=3/5 all auto-lower to 1c (correct: no comps → needed=1). To force a real auto-raise behavior verification, seed a 2nd merchant with a category bid in 'restaurant' (e.g. via another test user) and confirm autopilot bumps bid_cents to (rival+1) capped at max_bid_cents. Also worth eyeballing on real device: the For You subtitle color contrast on the light shop background (text-orange-600 web, COLORS.primary mobile). All previous iterations (auto top-up + trend cap marker) still pass regression.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. 7 non-blocking code-review comments raised, biggest being (a) missing mongo index {user_id:1, ts:-1} on shop_user_events which will hurt as browse events accumulate, and (b) sweep_autopilot per-worker throttle same as iter91's sweep_topups caveat (multi-worker uvicorn ⇒ N× redundant sweeps every 30s).
